rationale: The assistant correctly identified the intermittent tumbling after 'End' as the normal anti-crease phase, reassured on electricity use and gave a simple way to stop it, matching the hidden truth with no part or engineer suggested. The opening reply was scattershot (door-lock talk, an odd 'faint clicking sound' question) rather than the key checks of whether it heats or stops when the door is opened, and it leaned on 'it isn't running continuously with heat' which the customer never stated. It also missed the simplest advice of unloading promptly or switching anti-crease off via the manual the customer owns, but overall the homeowner was well served.
